## Other finding severities

The main table shows each rule's default severity; this section lists every condition under which a finding carries another severity, higher or lower. Changes follow [the severity policy](../compatibility.md#severity).

| Rule | Severity | When |
|---|---|---|
| `guardana.a2a.caller_identity` | LOW | the card declares no security scheme, the agent answers a caller with no credential, and the card's host is a loopback or private address |
| `guardana.agent.mcp_server_manifest` | CRITICAL | a pinned tool's live declaration differs from the digest approved by the pin |
| `guardana.mcp.registry_entry` | LOW | the version the server reports differs from the version in its registry entry |
| `guardana.mcp.scope_breadth` | LOW | the anonymous authorization challenge has no `scope` parameter |
| `guardana.mcp.session_binding` | CRITICAL | a request carrying only the session id, with the credential removed, returns the tool manifest |
| `guardana.mcp.session_binding` | CRITICAL | the server issues the same session id to more than one handshake |
| `guardana.mcp.session_binding` | CRITICAL | session ids differ only by an increasing number after a shared prefix |
| `guardana.mcp.unauthenticated_access` | LOW | the manifest is returned to an anonymous caller and the server is on a loopback or private address |
| `guardana.prompt.hidden_instructions` | LOW | invisible characters are present but are not shaped like an instruction payload |
| `guardana.prompt.hidden_instructions` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.prompt.mcp_tool_poisoning` | MEDIUM | a tool description contains a base64 blob of 48 or more characters |
| `guardana.prompt.mcp_tool_poisoning` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.chat_template` | HIGH | only an `include`, `extends`, `import` or `from` tag matches, with no dunder access, `attr` filter, Jinja global or code sink |
| `guardana.supply_chain.chat_template` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.code_execution` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.dependency_risk` | MEDIUM | a `yaml.load` call uses `Loader=FullLoader` |
| `guardana.supply_chain.dependency_risk` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.hallucinated_package` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.hardcoded_secret` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.insecure_transport` | MEDIUM | a fetch call uses a plaintext `http://` URL |
| `guardana.supply_chain.insecure_transport` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.keras_lambda` | MEDIUM | a `StringLookup`, `IntegerLookup` or `TextVectorization` layer reads its vocabulary from a file outside the model |
| `guardana.supply_chain.keras_lambda` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.malicious_dependency` | MEDIUM | a `setup.py` file fetches from the network at install time |
| `guardana.supply_chain.malicious_dependency` | MEDIUM | a pin matches a bundled vulnerable-loader advisory; the finding takes the advisory's severity (`medium` for every bundled advisory) |
| `guardana.supply_chain.malicious_dependency` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.model_format` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.notebook_payload` | LOW | a cell runs local scripts whose code the rule does not read |
| `guardana.supply_chain.notebook_payload` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.onnx_graph` | MEDIUM | a node or opset uses a domain outside the standard ONNX domains |
| `guardana.supply_chain.onnx_graph` | MEDIUM | a `metadata_props` value looks like code, such as `exec`, `eval`, `subprocess` or `b64decode` |
| `guardana.supply_chain.onnx_graph` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.pickle_opcode` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.provenance` | LOW | the model card names AGPL, non-commercial or no-redistribution terms |
| `guardana.supply_chain.provenance` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.remote_code` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.remote_code_config` | CRITICAL | a Hub kernel reference is set through the private key `_attn_implementation_internal` or `_attn_implementation` |
| `guardana.supply_chain.remote_code_config` | MEDIUM | a Hub kernel reference is set through the public key `attn_implementation` |
| `guardana.supply_chain.remote_code_config` | MEDIUM | an `auto_map` or `custom_pipelines` pointer names a module that is not present beside the config |
| `guardana.supply_chain.remote_code_config` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.supply_chain.saved_model_ops` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
| `guardana.training.dataset_integrity` | LOW | a `load_dataset(...)` call omits `revision=` or sets it to a value other than a literal commit SHA |
| `guardana.training.dataset_integrity` | LOW | the input cannot be read whole (unreadable, truncated, over the read bound or unparseable); the finding is inconclusive |
